title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4GRID - ComplexActionOperationInput
description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4grid/ComplexActionOperationInput. This class indicates that the parameter needed by the action to operate is complex (i.e. structure). Subclass of SAREF4GRID's own CosemOperationInput; inherits obtainInputFromObis (documented on the CosemOperationInput model and not repeated here). SAREF4GRID further specializes this class as PresetAdjustingTime and SpecialDayEntry, each adding its own structure fields (documented on their own models).

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'ComplexActionOperationInput'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.
